Sunway University
Department of Business
BUS2023 Entrepreneurship - Group Assignment

Background
Small food businesses in Petaling Jaya lost many customers during the recent floods, and many owners are now looking for new ways to reach buyers online. In this assignment your group will act as a team of consultants for one such business.

What you need to do
Choose one small food business near your campus and interview the owner about how the business works today. Use what you learn to propose a realistic plan that helps the business sell online within six months. Your plan should explain the target customers, the channels you recommend, the costs involved and how the owner will measure success. You will present the plan to the class in Week 12 and hand in a written business plan in Week 13.

The business plan should be about 3,000 words long. Online food sales in the Klang Valley grew by 12% last year, so use recent data wherever you can.

Contact your tutor during consultation hours if you have questions.
